name: gap_or_retest only when the resting book is thin at the retest
why: The retest holds when the book on the other side is thin. Pre-registered 2026-10-28 (research/preregistered/2026-10-28_new_families.md).

scan.when: !rollwin && abs(gap) >= 0.1 && ((sign(gap) > 0 && lo(5,1) <= rhi(15) && cl(5,1) > rhi(15)) || (sign(gap) < 0 && hi(5,1) >= rlo(15) && cl(5,1) < rlo(15))) && flow && (bkrel(bidq,15) + bkrel(askq,15))/2 <= d
